_comment: Average-speed sections mapped in OpenStreetMap whose enforcement relation has not reached speedcameramap.uk's monthly extract yet. Same shape as sections.json. Cameras are OSM nodes (surveyed 2026-10-05); the path between them is OSRM's route over OSM roads. Data © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0. uk_sections.py drops an entry automatically once an OSM section covers it.
